title: Maize Seed Germination Under Low-Temperature Stress Impacts Seedling Growth Under Normal Temperature by Modulating Photosynthesis and Antioxidant Metabolism
genotypes: B283-1 (low-temperature sensitive, SM); 04Qun0522-1-1 (low-temperature resistant, RM); both inbreds bred by the authors (Shandong Agricultural University)
stage_age: seeds germinated 4 d; sampled after 13 °C 4 d + 25 °C 2 d (LNT) or 25 °C 4 d (NT)
growth_system: growth chamber; seeds sown in silica sand (60% saturation moisture) in germination boxes; photoperiod NR
cold_treatments: 13 °C for 4 d followed by 25 °C for 2 d (LNT; RNA sampled after the 25 °C step, not at the end of the cold phase)
timepoints_duration: single sampling per treatment (LNT: 4 d 13 °C + 2 d 25 °C; NT: 4 d 25 °C); no cold time course
n_libraries: 12 (2 genotypes x 2 treatments x 3 reps; computed)
platform_layout: Illumina (NEBNext Ultra RNA Library Prep kit); paired-end; model and read length NR; 40-50 M clean reads per sample
other_omics: physiology (MDA, total antioxidant capacity, sucrose, SOD, POD, SPAD); qRT-PCR validation
key_finding: Germination at 13 °C down-regulated photosynthesis genes in both lines; sensitive line also down-regulated ribosome and SOD genes.
notes: DEGs LNT vs NT: SM 3186 up/4281 down; RM 2797 up/3918 down (padj<0.05, |log2FC|>=1); mapped to B73 v4 with HISAT2, DESeq2; the library is sampled after a 2 d warm step so it is cold germination followed by recovery, not cold itself

title: Prediction of conserved and variable heat and cold stress response in maize using cis-regulatory information
genotypes: B73; Mo17; W22; F1 hybrids B73xMo17, B73xW22, Mo17xW22 (replicated experiment); B73, Mo17, W22 (time course); diversity panel of 25 inbreds incl. B73, Mo17, W22 (other names not retrieved); no tolerance claims
n_genotypes: 6 in replicated experiment (3 inbreds + 3 F1); 25 inbreds in panel experiment
tissue: V2 leaf (pool of 3-4 seedlings per sample)
growth_system: growth chambers, 30/20 °C day/night with 16 h light/8 h dark until treatment; treatment started 2 h after dawn on day 9 (time 0); seeds hydrated 24 h; experiments run late May to early July 2019; substrate NR
control_temperature: 30/20 °C day/night (time-matched control) plus an unstressed time-0 sample
other_factors: heat treatment 39/29 °C in parallel against the same control; genotype (inbreds vs F1 hybrids; 25-inbred panel)
timepoints_duration: experiment 1: 0, 1, 25 h; experiment 2 (time course): 0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 8, 25 h (single replicate; W22 missing some points); experiment 3 (panel): 1 and 25 h cold vs control
n_libraries: 292 samples for cold, heat and control combined (126 + 66 + 100; one sample failed library prep and was omitted)
platform_layout: Illumina NovaSeq S4, PE150, TruSeq Stranded mRNA (University of Minnesota Genomics Center)
other_omics: none generated (cis-regulatory motif and machine-learning modelling)
key_finding: Cold and heat responses in three inbreds and F1 hybrids; cis-regulatory motifs predict responses; cis/trans variants explain genotype differences.
notes: Companion Plant Cell commentary PMID 35226744 (excluded) covers the same dataset; two 25 h replicated-experiment samples (HY91, HY93) were replaced by time-course samples; reads aligned to B73 AGPv4 with HISAT2 variant-aware index

title: Transcriptomic profiling of the high-vigour maize (Zea mays L.) hybrid variety response to cold and drought stresses during seed germination
genotypes: Zhongdi175 (hybrid H446 x Q317; described as high-vigour and stress resistant)
tissue: seedlings (10 uniform seedlings per replicate; organ not specified)
stage_age: seeds germinated 4 d at 25 °C, then treated 48 h (seedling establishment)
growth_system: germination paper rolls in an artificial climate incubator (GXZ-380C); 12 h light/12 h dark
cold_treatments: 4 ± 0.5 °C for 48 h (12 h light/12 h dark)
control_temperature: 25 ± 0.5 °C for 48 h (12 h light/12 h dark)
other_factors: drought (20% PEG6000 at 25 °C for 48 h) as a second stress
timepoints_duration: single 48 h exposure after 4 d germination at 25 °C
platform_layout: Illumina HiSeq 2500, paired-end (read length NR); Gene Denovo Biotechnology
other_omics: physiology (indices measured on remaining seedlings); qRT-PCR validation
key_finding: 9,605 DEGs under cold and 7,837 under drought; 5,143 shared; ribosome and phenylpropanoid pathways enriched.
notes: 12,299 DEGs in total (FC>=2, FDR<0.05, edgeR); TopHat2/Cufflinks against B73 RefGen_v4; Q30 > 92%

title: Natural variation in a type-A response regulator confers maize chilling tolerance
genotypes: LH244 (wild type); ZmRR1-overexpressing transgenic line in LH244 background (line name not retrievable from text); RNA-seq on these two only; other lines (CRISPR mutants of ZmRR1 and ZmMPK8, ZmMPK8-OE) and a 161-inbred panel were phenotyped but not sequenced
growth_system: greenhouse at 25 °C, 16 h light/8 h dark, ~200 µmol m-2 s-1, 60% RH, soil boxes; cold in a 4 °C light incubator with the same photoperiod, light and humidity
control_temperature: 25 °C, time 0 h before cold (not a time-matched 12 h warm control)
bio_reps: 2 independent replicates (each a pool of 3 seedlings)
n_libraries: 8 (2 genotypes x 2 time points x 2 reps; computed)
accession: not found (text says the dataset was deposited in an NCBI database; ID not in the retrieved text)
other_omics: LC-MS/MS phosphosite mapping; ZmRR1 association analysis in 161 inbreds; protein-level assays
key_finding: ZmRR1 overexpression raises ZmDREB1 and CesA expression and chilling tolerance; cold-activated ZmMPK8 phosphorylates ZmRR1 and promotes its degradation.
notes: Data availability section not in the retrieved text, so the accession needs a check on the publisher page; HISAT2 to B73 v4, Cuffdiff; 1,727 ZmRR1-regulated genes at 25 or 4 °C

title: Membrane Lipids' Metabolism and Transcriptional Regulation in Maize Roots Under Cold Stress
genotypes: He344 (major variety planted in northeast China; tolerance not stated)
growth_system: growth chamber; hydroponics in 1/2 Hoagland solution (pH 5.5); 22 °C with 16/8 h light/dark; seeds germinated in the dark at 25 °C
timepoints_duration: roots sampled 3 d after the start of cold
accession: not found (Data Availability cites an NCBI repository with four accession numbers; IDs not in the retrieved text)
repository: NCBI (per Data Availability statement; IDs not found)
other_omics: lipidomics (ESI-MS/MS, Kansas Lipidomics Research Center; n=5)
key_finding: Cold (5 °C) roots: phosphatidylcholine fell, phosphatidic acid rose; 189 lipid-related DEGs, PLD genes up-regulated.
notes: Mapped to B73 RefGen_v3 (GRMZM IDs); edgeR FDR<0.01 and |log2FC|>=1; accession IDs need a check on the publisher page

other_factors: local vs distal vs whole-plant chilling; tolerant vs sensitive lines
accession: GSE167156 (unverified: found by web search, GEO summary matches this abstract; GEO page could not be fetched)
other_omics: physiology (seedling lethality under shoot or root chilling)
key_finding: Chilling survival linked to ABA and transcriptional regulators in leaves and crowns; distal chilling response differs from local response.

title: Leaf transcriptomic response mediated by cold stress in two maize inbred lines with contrasting tolerance levels
control_temperature: time 0 before cold (no separate warm control stated in abstract)
accession: PRJNA666026 (unverified candidate: BioProject 'Transcriptome sequencing of Maize Inbred Lines: B144, q319', 18 runs SRR12726809-SRR12726826, found by web search; link to this paper not confirmed)
key_finding: Tolerant B144 protects photosystem II by raising D1 proteins; sensitive Q319 cannot close stomata; MAPK, hormone and circadian pathways involved.
source_of_details: abstract + web search (full text not retrieved)
